newsitem.title: USA: Auxer to incorporate under Delaware law.
newsitem.headline: Auxer to incorporate under Delaware law.

text.p: Auxer Industries Inc said Monday its board has approved a move to incorporate under Delaware law.
The holding company, which is currently incorporated under Idaho law, said it has scheduled a stockholders' meeting to approve the change of corporate domicile.
A company spokesman said Auxer will hold a shareholders' meeting "very shortly" to approve the change.
